Perplexity is quite useful for business owners

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-26T16:53:21+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2125996340895514904; média: videó, 59 másodperc]
A business asked Perplexity to preview jacket embroidery before they sew a sample.

Computer found the ZigZag MCP and built this app, which lets the business check thread colors, estimate stitch time, and export designs as DST & PES files for embroidery machines.
